Use the current tables for regular-season standings plus complete batting, pitching, and player-position fielding lines. Parameterized functions cover historical seasons, AL or NL restriction, spring training and postseason game types, official qualified leaderboards, advanced metrics, career totals, team-specific lines for traded players, and per-game logs with optional date bounds. rows.vgi.doc_md:
# MLB standings and player statistics

Query current and historical Major League Baseball data directly from SQL. The catalog contains team standings and complete batting, pitching, and fielding season lines, plus advanced metrics, career totals, team splits, and per-game logs.

## Data model

Current tables are the quickest entry point. Parameterized functions select seasons, leagues, game types, qualified pools, or individual players. Multi-team season totals never claim to belong to one club: use the team-split functions when attribution matters.

All access is read-only and requires no credential. Rate statistics are exact decimals; baseball innings remain display strings alongside exact integer outs.
